sentences.text: 3 a n d 4

Coram : Alok Aradhe, Cj.
 Date : 10 July 2025

In this Petition, the Petitioner, inter-alia, seeks direction to the executing Court to decide the
application preferred by the Petitioner on 17 February 2015 and to quash and set aside the order
dated 6 March 2014.
2. Facts giving rise to filing of this Petition in nut shell are that an award under the provisions of Land Acquistion Act, 1894 was passed.
In pursuance of the aforesaid award, the State Government deposited the amount of compensation in the execution proceedings.

In the execution proceedings,
the Petitioner made an application seeking payment of the amount of her share.
The aforesaid application has been rejected by the JPP 7. WP 6424.2014.doc impugned order, inter-alia, on the ground that the Petitioner should file a separate suit in respect of her share.
In the aforesaid factual background, this Petition has been filed.
3. I have heard the learned Counsel for the parties at length.

on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88713285/
1 4.
This Petition is pending before this Court since 2014.
The Court ought to have decided the dispute in relation to aportionment of the amount instead of relegating the Petitioner to the remedy of filing a separate suit.
In case the list between the parties is still alive, the Court is directed to decide the application seeking aportionment of the amount after affording an opportunity of hearing to the parties.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.

( CHIEF JUSTICE )
